# Wappalyzer fixture

`technologies.json` holds 14 entries copied verbatim from
[enthec/webappanalyzer](https://github.com/enthec/webappanalyzer) at commit
`d91f7e510e93457041bea874e8a9ffb011e3e4fe` (`src/technologies/*.json`). They are real
upstream data used only by the unit tests; they are not part of the built extension.

This directory is licensed **GPL-3.0**, like its source, and is excluded from the MIT license
that covers the rest of the repository.
